findings.location: main else branch for absent original MappingEvidence claim
findings.observation: A changed payload and any LLM_SUGGESTION at the prior evidence index currently suffice to classify an absent claim as scientifically reassessed. There is no loaded full-before/full-after claim correspondence or selected-payload binding check. An unrelated or shifted claim could be attributed as its replacement.
findings.reproduction: Read frozen helper lines in branch beginning if matches/else: idx is parsed from the original field and successor=es[idx]. Only changed capture, index range, LLM_SUGGESTION and absence from historical preimage are asserted.
findings.bounded_fix: Load and validate the exact source-author original→successor complete-claim correspondence, original/new payload hashes, explicit source index if supplied, and selected proposal retirement bridge. Find the unique exact successor claim by its full value; reject absent, ambiguous, stale or wrong-context correspondence. Do not infer replacement by same slot.
findings.scientific_effect: No science re-evaluation required; this protects attribution of already reviewed corrected claims.

findings.location: main authentic-before reads before mutation and final MANUAL exclusion check
findings.observation: p.before_sha256 controls whether an owner is read but the actual maintained owner bytes are never compared with that digest. The historical-exclusion comparison can therefore consume a stale owner. The helper also does not enforce each row current_capture/owner/before hash against its original selected proposal despite those bindings being available.
findings.reproduction: Both owner reads use yaml.safe_load(R/p.owner_path) if p.before_sha256 else{}. Current123row input audit confirms hashes happen to match now, but helper has no stale-owner refusal path.
findings.bounded_fix: Verify the maintained preimage SHA before parsing/using it, bind row capture/path/preimage to its exact original selected proposal, and recheck or preserve the authenticated baseline through final readback. Add a negative stale-owner/context control.
findings.current_state: Independent checks found no actual stale owner or row-context mismatch in all123 current rows; this is a missing fail-closed check before execution.
